title.provenance: Introduced By: Representatives Cortvriend, Speakman, Carson, Morales, Marszalkowski,  McGaw, Ruggiero,  Fogarty, Donovan, and Kislak Date Introduced: February 11, 2022

location.provenance: IN GENERAL ASSEMBLY JANUARY SESSION, A.D. 2022

reference.provenance: Referred To: House Environment and Natural Resources

status.provenance: It is enacted by the General Assembly as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Prohibition/Schedule for removal of incidental amounts

who.provenance: No package or packaging component shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state

products.provenance: No food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes

exceptions.provenance: No exceptions are mentioned for PFAS in food packaging

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The text does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentional introduction of PFAS means deliberately utilizing PFAS in the formulation of a package or packaging component
